# Blue jute curtain

Type: Furniture | Internal ID: piece_cloth_hanging_door_blue2 | Source: Workbench | Usage: Decoration | Crafting Materials: Blue jute x4, Finewood x1 | Support: Wood (from 10 to 100) | Loss: 1/8 vertical, 1/5 horizontal | Weak to (x1.5): Chop | Neutral to (x1): Slash, ,, Pickaxe, ,, Fire, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning | Resistant to (x0.5): Blunt, ,, Pierce | Immune to (x0): Poison, ,, Spirit

# Introduction

Blue jute curtain is a decorative object. It needs to be built within the range of a Workbench.
Blue jute curtains can also be found adorning the Dvergr structures built of Black marble throughout the Mistlands. There, they can be broken to obtain their Blue jute. Although, if a player damages them, or any other structure in range of a Dvergr Ward, nearby Dvergr will become hostile and attack players.
